title: Glasswater Fen

deliverables.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create game TERRAIN sprite atlas, NOT illustration or prop sheet. Handpainted Lanterns Underroot style from first reference. EXACT1024x1024 square image divided into4columns4rows of256px identical fixed square cells. Exactly16cells, each contains ONE modular terrain piece. NO spanning cells. Wet moss stone and mud, subdued cyan undertones. Row1 top-left cap, top-center flat, top-right cap, isolated flat block. Row2 leftwall,opaque square fillA,opaque square fillB,rightwall. Row3 bottomleft,bottomcenter,bottomright,isolated ledge. Row4 insidecornerleft,insidecornerright,upstairs,downstairs. NO lamps books gears windows arches banners water plants grass props or shadows. Flat side-on collision tops, no perspective tilt. Alpha transparency outside solid material; no gutters or gridlines or text. Treat as modular architectural texture blocks, simple silhouettes, NOT floating scenic islands.
